content: Notification prefs: all-or-nothing toggles cause opt-out; users expect per-category (posts, comments/replies, likes, mentions, DMs, events) x per-channel (in-app, push, email) control plus frequency (immediate/daily digest/mute). Push for out-of-app moments; in-app center for in-session. Grouping/batching of likes reduces noise. Prompt for push permission only after a user gesture, ideally after a value moment.
